descriptions.value: In multiple locations, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds read via direct memory access in video decoder firmware due to a logic error. This could lead to local information disclosure with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
Use after free in Windows Kerberos allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.
